EAA · Directive (EU) 2019/882

European Accessibility Act Kit: from scope check to published statement.

Since 28 June 2025 the European Accessibility Act applies to online shops, banking, e-books, transport and many other services. This kit gives you a clear process from scope check to published statement.

Directive (EU) 2019/882

What's in the kit

  • Scope Checker — which products and services are covered, with the microenterprise exemption built in
  • Authority Directory — national EAA law and market surveillance authority per country, with official links
  • Digital Assets — your websites, shops, apps and documents in one list
  • WCAG 2.1 AA Audit Checklist — all 50 success criteria with a plain-English “what to check”
  • Issue Tracker — every failure with severity, owner, fix-by date and retest
  • Feedback & Complaints Log and Disproportionate Burden Assessments (Art. 14, Annex VI)
  • Setup guide and an accessibility statement template, ready to adapt
  • Example rows, an FAQ and a key-facts table

The rules it covers

  • Since 28 June 2025

    The EAA applies to covered products and services placed on the EU market, including online shops, banking, e-books, transport and electronic communications.

  • Microenterprise exemption

    Microenterprises providing services (fewer than 10 staff and no more than €2 million turnover or balance sheet) are exempt from the requirements for services.

  • WCAG 2.1 AA in practice

    The harmonised standard EN 301 549 builds on WCAG 2.1 level AA, which is why the audit checklist covers all 50 success criteria.

Made for

  • E-commerce owners

  • Service providers selling to consumers in the EU

Questions about this kit

Does the EAA apply to my online shop?
If you sell to consumers in the EU and are not a microenterprise, very likely. The scope checker walks you through the covered products and services.
What is a disproportionate burden?
A business can argue that a requirement would be a disproportionate burden (Art. 14, Annex VI), but it has to document the assessment. The kit includes a log for exactly that.
Is there a Word or Excel edition?
Not yet. This kit is currently available as a Notion template only. The free Notion plan is enough: after purchase you click “Duplicate” and the kit is copied into your own workspace.
